description: Performance drill-down for the quota apiserver. Surfaces bottlenecks across the claim hot path, storage backend, policy engine workqueue, and Go runtime.

panels.description: Total quota apiserver request rate across all verbs and resources.
panels.title: Request rate

panels.description: 5xx response rate. Non-zero indicates server-side failures.
panels.title: Error rate (5xx)

panels.description: 99th percentile request latency across all non-streaming verbs.
panels.title: p99 latency (all verbs)

panels.description: Requests currently being served. Rising values can indicate saturation.
panels.title: In-flight requests

panels.description: Distribution of request latency across the full histogram. Use this to spot bimodal latency.
panels.title: Request duration heatmap

panels.description: APF (API Priority and Fairness) rejections. Non-zero indicates the apiserver is shedding load.
panels.title: Flow-control rejected requests

panels.description: Mutating vs read-only in-flight requests. Quota CLAIM creates are mutating.
panels.title: In-flight requests by kind

panels.description: Claims processed per second, split by outcome (granted / denied / error). Sourced from internal/metrics/metrics.go.
panels.title: Claim decision rate by result

panels.description: Time from QuotaClaim CREATE arrival to transactional decision. Drill into tail latency here.
panels.title: Claim decision latency (p50 / p95 / p99)

panels.description: Decision latency distribution. A long upper tail points at bucket contention or storage lag.
panels.title: Claim decision latency heatmap

panels.description: Denial = quota exhausted. Conflict = optimistic lock collision on bucket status (hot row).
panels.title: Claim apiserver errors (denial / conflict)

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, resource) (rate(apiserver_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", resource=~"quota.*", verb=~"POST|PUT|PATCH|DELETE"}[$__rate_interval])))
sum by (resource) (rate(apiserver_request_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", resource=~"quota.*", verb=~"POST|PUT|PATCH|DELETE", code=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.description: Per-operation storage latency. Spikes here propagate directly into claim decision latency.
panels.title: p99 storage op latency

panels.description: Only present when the etcd backend is in use.
panels.title: p99 etcd request duration

panels.description: Apparent etcd database size. Sustained growth without compaction indicates retention problems.
panels.title: etcd DB size

panels.description: Any non-zero value is a signal — leader churn causes request latency spikes.
panels.title: etcd leader changes

panels.description: WAL fsync latency. The etcd "slow fsync" warning fires at 1s — keep this well under 100ms.
panels.title: p99 etcd WAL fsync

panels.description: quota_policies_active = current count in the shared informer cache. quota_policy_load_total = full-reload rate.
panels.title: Active policies & load rate

panels.description: Items queued for reconciliation. Sustained growth indicates the policy engine cannot keep up.
panels.title: Workqueue depth

panels.description: How long a work item takes once dequeued. This is the policy engine reconcile latency.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, name) (rate(workqueue_work_duration_seconds_bucket{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", name=~"quota.*"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: p99 workqueue work duration

panels.description: Time an item sits in the queue before a worker picks it up. High values = worker starvation.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, name) (rate(workqueue_queue_duration_seconds_bucket{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", name=~"quota.*"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: p99 workqueue queue duration

panels.description: Retry rate. Non-zero retries usually indicate transient conflicts or downstream errors.
panels.title: Workqueue retries

panels.description: Stuck or slow reconciles show up here before they show up in latency histograms.
panels.title: Longest running processor / unfinished work

panels.description: Open long-running WATCH requests per resource. apiserver_registered_watchers is deprecated — apiserver_longrunning_requests replaces it.
panels.title: Active watches

panels.description: Rate of new WATCH requests being opened (not the event stream rate). Event-stream volume is visible via Row 8 policy-informer events for our own caches.
panels.title: Watch establishment rate

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, resource) (rate(apiserver_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", verb="LIST", resource=~"quota.*"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, resource) (rate(apiserver_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", verb="GET", resource=~"quota.*"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, resource) (rate(apiserver_response_sizes_bucket{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", resource=~"quota.*"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.description: If quantile buckets are unavailable on this Go version, fall back to go_gc_duration_seconds{quantile="0.99"}.
panels.title: GC pause p99
